description: The state section (default empty) — genre-neutral named cells (see WorldStateRow): score, rounds, inventory, flags, or a keyed table (a slot is a table with one key — the primitive threat tables and the signed-carriage bearer high-water mark both want). It is simulation state: every row's whole shape mutates only through UpsertStateRow/RemoveStateRow, or — for a per-cell write only — UpsertStateCell/RemoveStateCell; the same journaled/undoable/saved pipeline every other section rides. A genre world is different data here, never a new message shape or an engine-interpreted name.
